todos.title: Prevent app-server events from blocking RPC responses — review fix impl
todos.description: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression. Match official codex app-server-client semantics: unread notifications or server requests must not block foreground RPC responses; start an event pump for every connection epoch and fail closed on unsupported server requests.
todos.source: 2026-08-29 real-device regression and upstream codex app-server-client
todos.notes: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression

verification.summary: Aligned the Go client with upstream codex app-server-client's non-blocking event invariant: every Client epoch owns a fresh event pump, and unsupported Phase 1 server requests are explicitly rejected instead of filling an unread bounded queue and hiding later RPC responses.

todos.title: Reproduce and test event backpressure isolation — review fix tests
todos.description: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression. Flood server requests and replace a bound client epoch, then prove foreground RPC responses and notification delivery continue without bounded-channel deadlock.
todos.source: 2026-08-29 real-device regression and upstream codex app-server-client
todos.notes: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression

verification.summary: Race tests flooded 100 unsupported server requests ahead of a foreground response and replaced Client epochs repeatedly; RPC response delivery and new-epoch notifications remained live. The full codex-remote race suite and six relevant go-bridge tests passed repeatedly.

todos.title: Close the app-server event backpressure regression — review fix regression
todos.description: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression. Build and install the repaired runtime, verify real Remote Control RPC remains responsive, preserve the owner bidirectional device evidence, and restore the original gate only with resolved-via evidence.
todos.source: 2026-08-29 real-device regression and upstream codex app-server-client
todos.notes: review-fix-for:phase1-gate-regression
